purpose_context: The lane, worktree and coordination model is the largest single source of friction. This Mission applies the operator rulings: one status read contract, the for_review gate reading lane branches, lane checkouts that never show status files, approval windows for single_branch, topology settled at finalize-tasks by Mission size, cleanup as the last consolidation step, plus the ADRs for short-lived checkouts and worktree-free coordination writes.
purpose_tldr: Make lanes, worktrees and the status surface simpler and safer, per the 2026-11-06 operator rulings (epic #7276).
